_: Overrides that must not touch a page's HTML. A page can also set <meta name="card:headline|caption|photo|image"> itself, which wins over this file. Everything not listed here is derived from the page. See docs/SHARE-CARDS.md.
_rule: Every public page gets its own card with its own photo, automatically. The only exceptions are the pages listed in shared.pages: legal and plain contact pages with nothing of their own to say, which all use the one brand card. Add a page to shared.pages only if it fits that description. See docs/SHARE-CARDS.md.
